name: Voibe Transcription
description:
Give ears to Claude. Voibe turns recordings into text Claude can work with.

Ask Claude to transcribe a meeting, interview, call, lecture, podcast episode or voice memo. The raw transcript arrives in the chat with speaker labels, timestamps and a summary. Attach the file in Claude chat, or point at a file or folder in Claude Code, where a whole folder of recordings works in one instruction. Ask to list your recent transcriptions or check your remaining minutes.

**What you can do with the transcript**
The transcript lands in the conversation, so the real work starts immediately:
**A meeting** becomes minutes with decisions and action items.
**A user interview or hiring interview** becomes attributed quotes.
**A sales call** becomes the follow-up email.
**A podcast episode** becomes show notes and chapter markers.
**A lecture** becomes study notes.
**A voice memo** becomes a to-do list.
**A support call** becomes a score against your rubric.
**Several calls** become one report: what customers said about pricing.

**What comes back**
**Who said what:** every speaker told apart, every line with start and end times. When people say their names, the summary uses them.
**A summary in the shape you ask for:** decisions only, action items with owners, bullet points.
**Multilingual:** the recording does not have to be in English.
**Files up to 200 MB** in common audio and video formats (mp3, wav, m4a, mp4, flac, ogg, webm and more).

**Your audio**
We delete your audio the moment the transcript exists. We never use it to train models. Transcripts and summaries stay readable for 24 hours, so transcribe and work on the result in the same sitting.

**Pricing**
Signing in creates your account with 15 free minutes. No card and no subscription. After that, buy one-time minute packs that never expire. You pay per second of audio, and only when a job finishes. Failed jobs cost nothing.

From the makers of the Voibe dictation app.
Docs: platform.getvoibe.com/docs/mcp

_published_faq.name: How do I add Voibe Transcription to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Voibe Transcription to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.getvoibe.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Voibe Transcription MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voibe Transcription provides these MCP tools: create_transcription_job, get_balance, get_transcript, and list_transcripts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Voibe Transcription?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Voibe Transcription in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Voibe Transcription MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voibe Transcription requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Voibe Transcription is developed by Voibe. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
